## 4K PC MONITORS (3840x2160) - COMPREHENSIVE COMPARISON FOR PRODUCTIVITY & CODING

### EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
I've researched 4K monitors from Dell, Samsung, LG, and Asus available in the UK market (September 2026). The findings show significant price variation from **£280-£1,099** for single monitors, enabling various dual-monitor configurations within your 700 GBP budget. Best value for coding/productivity: Dell S2725QS/S2725QC at ~£280-290.

---

### COMPREHENSIVE 4K MONITOR COMPARISON TABLE

|-------|-------|------------|------|-----------|--------------|------------|-----------|----------------|-----------------|----------------------|------------|

---

### RECOMMENDED CONFIGURATIONS FOR CODING & PRODUCTIVITY

#### **BUDGET DUAL-MONITOR SETUP (£500–650 total)**
| Configuration | Total Cost | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **2× Dell S2725QC** | £559.30 | **BEST VALUE** - Two 27" 4K monitors with 120Hz, USB-C for charging laptop + dual 4K workspace. Ideal for coding: split editor/terminal on one screen, code/documentation on the other. |
| **2× Dell S2725QS** | £578.00 | Similar to above but with DisplayPort instead of USB-C. Slightly cheaper. Both support full ergonomic height adjustment. |
| **1× Dell S3225QS + 1× Dell S2725QC** | £598.62 | Mixed 27"/32" setup for varied workflow: larger screen for main work area + secondary productivity screen. |

**Budget Assessment:** ✅ **FITS 700 GBP BUDGET EASILY** - Up to 2 quality 4K monitors + £100+ headroom

---

#### **MID-RANGE DUAL-MONITOR SETUP (£600–750 total)**
| Configuration | Total Cost | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **1× Dell U2725QE + 1× Dell S2725QC** | £829.63 | **NOT within budget** - But offers Thunderbolt 4 hub on one monitor for laptop charging; only one needs to daisy-chain with second monitor. |
| **1× LG 32UN650-W + 1× Dell S2725QC** | £909.59 | Professional color accuracy (DCI-P3 95%) on primary monitor + budget secondary. For creative coding workflows. |
| **1× Dell AW2725QF + 1× Dell S2725QC** | £669.79 | ✅ **FITS BUDGET** - Gaming-class 180Hz + productivity 120Hz. Best for high-performance coding environments. |

---

#### **SINGLE PREMIUM MONITOR (FOR CONCENTRATED WORK)**
| Model | Price | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|
| **Dell U2725QE** (Thunderbolt 4) | £549.98 | **BEST SINGLE 4K** for coders - One cable for power, display, data. 99% DCI-P3 color, 120Hz smooth scrolling. Ideal for MacBook users. |
| **Dell S2725QC** (USB-C 65W) | £279.65 | **BUDGET BEST** - USB-C with power delivery for laptop charging. Unbeatable value for money. |
| **Dell S3225QS** | £318.97 | **PRODUCTIVITY SWEET SPOT** - 31.5" screen real estate at budget price, 120Hz refresh rate. |

---

### SPECIALIZED RECOMMENDATIONS BY USE CASE

#### **1. Software Developers / Coding Focus**
- **Primary Choice:** Dell S2725QC (£279.65) or Dell U2725QE (£549.98)
- **Reason:** USB-C/Thunderbolt for laptop charging + docking, 120Hz for smooth scrolling through long code files, IPS panels with good color accuracy
- **Dual Setup:** 2× S2725QC = £559.30 (£140 under budget) — allows split terminal/editor workflow
- **USB-C Power:** S2725QC charges laptops at 65W while displaying 4K — eliminates need for separate power adapter

#### **2. Visual/UX Designers**
- **Primary Choice:** Dell U2725QE (£549.98) or Asus ProArt PA279CDV (~£600 est.)
- **Reason:** 99% DCI-P3 color gamut, professional color accuracy (ΔE < 1.5 on ProArt)
- **Dual Setup:** ProArt PA279CDV + S2725QC = ~£880 (over budget, but exceptional for color work)

#### **3. Professional Video/Content Creators**
- **Primary Choice:** Asus ProArt PA329CDV (32", ~£750 est.) or Dell U3225QE (31.5", £767.88)
- **Reason:** Larger 32" workspace, Thunderbolt/USB-C connectivity for fast file transfer, 99% DCI-P3 color space

#### **4. Gaming/High-Performance Coding**
- **Primary Choice:** Dell AW3225QF (31.6", £687.75) or Asus ROG Swift OLED (27", £998.99)
- **Reason:** 240Hz OLED panels for extremely smooth animations, fast response times, ideal for real-time development testing
- **Budget Dual:** AW3225QF + S2725QC = £967.40 (exceeds budget but viable for performance-critical work)

#### **5. Professional Business/Enterprise Coding**
- **Primary Choice:** Dell P3225QE (£467.64) - Professional business monitor
- **Reason:** RJ45 Ethernet, USB-C (90W), DisplayPort for enterprise networks, robust design
- **Dual Setup:** 2× P3225QE = £935.28 (exceeds budget, but exceptional for corporate environments)

---

### KEY FINDINGS FOR YOUR 700 GBP BUDGET

✅ **EXCELLENT NEWS:** Your 700 GBP budget is generous for dual 4K monitors
- **Recommended:** 2× Dell S2725QC @ £279.65 each = **£559.30 total** (£140 under budget)
- **Alternative:** 2× Dell S2725QS @ £289 each = **£578 total** (£122 under budget)
- **Premium Dual:** 1× Dell U2725QE + 1× Dell S2725QC = **£829.63** (slightly over budget but premium experience)

---

### CONNECTIVITY & POWER DELIVERY COMPARISON (For Laptop Integration)

| Monitor | USB-C Power Delivery | Thunderbolt | Best For |
|---------|-------------------|------------|----------|
| Dell S2725QC | ✅ 65W | ❌ No | Most laptops, direct charging while displaying |
| Dell U2725QE | ❌ No | ✅ Thunderbolt 4 (140W EPR) | MacBooks, professional Mac workflows |
| Asus ProArt PA279CDV | ✅ 96W | ❌ No | Windows + laptop charging at high wattage |
| Samsung ViewFinity S80UD | ✅ 90W | ❌ No | Premium USB-C experience |
| Asus ROG Swift PG27UCWM | ✅ 90W | ❌ No | Gaming + productivity hybrid workload |

---

### FINAL RECOMMENDATIONS FOR YOUR SETUP

**TIER 1 - BEST VALUE (RECOMMENDED):**
- **Buy:** 2× Dell S2725QC @ £279.65 each
- **Total:** £559.30 (£140 under budget)
- **Why:** Best productivity monitors at this price, USB-C power delivery, 120Hz, excellent build quality
- **Ideal for:** Coding, document review, dual-screen workflow

**TIER 2 - PREMIUM SINGLE SCREEN:**
- **Buy:** 1× Dell U2725QE @ £549.98
- **Total:** £549.98 (£150 under budget)
- **Why:** Thunderbolt 4 single-cable solution, 99% DCI-P3, professional color accuracy
- **Ideal for:** Mac users, concentrated work, color-critical tasks

**TIER 3 - MIXED PRODUCTIVITY/GAMING:**
- **Buy:** 1× Dell AW3225QF @ £687.75 + 1× Dell S2725QC @ £279.65
- **Total:** £967.40 (exceeds budget by £267)
- **Note:** Premium gaming monitor paired with productivity, only if performance is critical
